To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the fracture load of CAD/CAM crowns was influenced by the material used for abutment dies.
the fracture loads of feldspar ceramic CAD/CAM crowns are significantly influenced by the mechanical properties of the abutment material.
hybrid ceramic and human dentin were the most suitable abutment materials for testing the fracture load of CAD/CAM feldspathic crowns.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question which abutment material can be used as a reference for the testing of dental restorations.
the question of whether the abutment material influences the fracture load of CAD/CAM feldspathic crowns.
the development of a method for the fabrication of standardized test samples for in vitro studies on the mechanical properties of CAD/CAM ceramic restorations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of hybrid ceramic abutment dies is recommended for in vitro testing of CAD/CAM crowns.
hybrid ceramic and human tooth abutment materials are more similar to each other than to reinforced composite and polymethyl methacarylate abutment dies in terms of fracture loads of ceramic crowns.
hybrid ceramic is the material that resembles human tooth most closely.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of human teeth is recommended for the fabrication of abutment models for fracture load testing.
the use of reinforced composite abutment dies in in vitro studies is recommended.
the use of human teeth as abutment materials is recommended in fracture load tests of CAD/CAM feldspar ceramic restorations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of hybrid ceramic as a substitute for human dentin is recommended for mechanical studies.
a hybrid ceramic abutment material is a valid substitute for natural teeth in fracture load tests of dental reconstructions.
a hybrid ceramic abutment material is a suitable substitute for human teeth in in vitro fracture testing.
